ratings_why.fun: Hold or run is a real choice every turn, and chains like Ned launder, Bond Clerk age, Stoker burn reward planning; a few plain buffers keep it from an 8.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because the shelf turns the shop, the pool and even the enemy board (Rufa's stolen copies, fielded by Grisel or tripled via the Keeper) into your resources; no tribe today plays outside the shop.

verdict_why: One real rules gap: whether Grisel's copies run their own Start of Combat text, which the best combos hinge on.

points.text: Say whether Grisel's copies fire their own Start of Combat effects (a shelved Sentry, Wenna, Rufa or a second Grisel). The answer decides whether the hold lane's top combos exist.
Rufa steals a copy, Bond Clerk ages it, Grisel fields it, the Keeper lets it finish a triple: you can triple the enemy's units. Keep this chain and name it in a build.

Honest Ned feeds the heron side too: launder your carry for +2/+2, let Bond Clerk age it, then buy it back or burn it with the Stoker. Hold versus run gets decided per unit, which is the best decision in the tribe.
Fence plus a bought-back unit selling for 1 makes buy back for 2, sell for 2 a free loop twice a turn that pumps Nan's counter and Pebble Jack. Nice hidden combo; the cap keeps it bounded.
Tibby is the only card that ignores the shelf and Contraband; a version that, say, grows when the redirected hit lands on a Contraband attacker's neighbour would tie it in.

standouts.why: Grisel turns the shelf into an army and its copies being Contraband bridges both lanes.
Honest Ned makes any tribe's When played effect repeatable and feeds both lanes.
Rufa turns fights into shop goods, stealing enemy units onto your shelf.

weakest.why: Tibby Slick does not touch the tribe's engine at all.
Narrows Sentry is a plain count-the-shelf body with no second use.
Oilskin Molly is a flat End of Turn buffer that only does the obvious job.

flags.note: Unstated whether copies trigger their own Start of Combat text, and whether a copy of a shelved Grisel summons more copies.
Wenna after Grisel buffs every Grisel copy per shelf unit; with Nan too this stacks high.
Ned laundering your carry onto an empty shelf lets the Auctioneer spread half of it to every Contraband unit each turn.
Fence makes buy-back-and-sell free twice a turn, which inflates Nan Silverholt's counter.
